name: Vanilla Cream Pie Filling
subtitle: Aunt Michelle’s standard
notes: Can be adjusted for coconut, banana, and chocolate.

source.label: From the Better Home and Garden’s red gingham cookbook

items: ⅓ cup flour or 3 Tbsp cornstarch
1 Tbsp vanilla (or other flavoring if desired: chocolate chips, coconut flavoring, etc.)

steps.title: Cook the custard
steps.body: In a saucepan, combine **¾ cup sugar**, **⅓ cup flour or 3 Tbsp cornstarch** and **¼ tsp salt**. Gradually whisk in **2 cups milk**. Stir over medium-high heat until bubbly, then cook and stir 2 minutes more.

steps.title: Temper the egg yolks
steps.body: Remove from heat, and stir a moderate amount of the hot mixture into **3 slightly beaten egg yolks**.

steps.title: Finish cooking
steps.body: Return the egg yolks and hot mixture to the saucepan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.

steps.title: Add butter and vanilla
steps.body: Remove from heat. Add **2 Tbsp butter** and **1 Tbsp vanilla** (or other flavoring if desired: chocolate chips, coconut flavoring, etc.).

steps.title: Fill the pie
steps.body: Pour into cooled baked pastry shell. To prevent skin from forming on surface of filling, put waxed paper directly on top of hot filling.

yields: About 2½ cups filling, enough for one 9-inch pie (estimated)
